facts.value: UL staff participating in Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Training must ensure that the receiving institution/enterprise is either a university awarded with an Erasmus Charter for Higher Education or any public or private organisation such as a small, medium or large enterprise (including social enterprises), a public body at local, regional or national level, a social partner or other representative of working life, including chambers of commerce, craft/professional associations and trade unions, a research institute, a foundation, a school/institute/educational centre, a non-profit organisation, association or NGO, or a body providing career guidance, professional counselling, and information services.
